progress.text: (M10, #5130): Windows Printer default sends native two-sided bindings only when automatic duplex support is confirmed, preserving manual driver defaults (#5130/#5772); physical output remains unqualified. Both Windows submission paths preserve DLL guards and current spooler fixes. Review follow-up validates both duplex scopes through craft-print 9fe50c94 and corrects CI formatting. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, comment exchange): Comments keep their formatting and appearance through XFDF and FDF. XFDF export and import carry rich text, default style, border width, style and dash pattern, rotation, justification, fringe, line leaders and captions, the caret symbol and redaction overlay text as XFDF 3.0 (ISO 19444-1) names them, and a stamp's appearance as <appearance> (the DICT/STREAM/DATA encoding, bounded); copy and paste carries every comment's appearance. FDF export keeps a stamp's /AP with its forms and images, as XFDF does, and FDF import keeps any /AP the file carries (ISO 32000-2 §12.7.8.3.4). The intent goes out as both intent and IT. An unreadable XFDF appearance is left out, said in the import report and the repair log, and the comment is drawn by PdfCraft; an FDF past the import budget is refused whole. A redaction mark is always drawn by PdfCraft.

(M2, #6449): A non-embedded Times New Roman set as a TrueType CID font (TimesNewRoman,Bold, TimesNewRomanPSMT and the other faces) draws the glyphs its codes name, as the non-embedded Arial does: its first 258 glyphs follow the same standard Macintosh order, which the embedded Times New Roman subsets of a public French form confirm in 941 of 942 /ToUnicode entries (vendored hayro-interpret patch 88). That form drew "Salarié(e) du régime général" as "Salari²g+f w't²i lo g'ì²p²tcn" and "changement" as "ej angement". Times and Times New Roman MT Std are not read this way.

(M7, #2964 / #3185): Supported Form text can be prepared for direct editing; groups left grouped (unsafe compositing, text nested past eight levels) are reported. Legacy Thai keeps the original font programs, Regular/Bold and text settings, also across same-face subsets; the narrow THSarabunPSK map repair is checked glyph by glyph against the font program; cross-family replacement is explicit. Builds on #3067 and #2811. Unsafe groups and mixed contextual styles remain partial; estimates unchanged.

(M10, ocr.ocr-web, port onto #977): Web OCR rebuilt on main's engines and preprocessing (#977). OcrJob::run is now OcrJob::steps a page at a time: the page renders, crops to the region and cleans each page, a Web Worker runs ocrs on the result, and OcrShot::place maps the words back through the region and preprocessing. Every strategy reads like this when only one engine is present, and the web build has only ocrs. The downloaded models are installed into the engine cache (ocr::install), so the Verify screen and the engine-status checks see them too. The batch keeps main's skipped-files bucket, low-confidence notes and cancel. The translations moved to craft-i18n (storytold/craft-i18n#141). The Verify screen starts the model download itself and runs once the models land; before, on a fresh page it failed with the desktop's "set PDFCRAFTMODELS" message. Known limits: the cleaning steps, and the Verify screen's Run OCR and re-reads, run on the page. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, #5889): A non-embedded Arial set as a TrueType CID font (CIDFontType2, Identity-H, as Word and PDFMaker write it) draws the glyphs its codes name. Those codes are glyph indexes in the author's Arial, whose first 258 glyphs follow the standard Macintosh order, so the standard substitute now draws each glyph by name (vendored hayro-interpret patch 76). Before, it took each code as one of its own glyph indexes, and "Low Power" drew as "@ck 'Dck Yf". Arial Narrow, Black and Unicode MS, and CIDFontType0 fonts, are not read this way. Copying or searching those runs still needs a /ToUnicode.

(M11, shared JBIG2 dictionary): With Monochrome Images set to JBIG2, Optimize has up to 16 JBIG2 images share one symbol dictionary (/JBIG2Globals), the letters found on more than one page stored once, when that is smaller (pdfcraftfilters::encodejbig2shared). Eight pages of 10 pt text rendered at 300 dpi take 41% less in Helvetica and 42% in Times than coded alone, 10% in Courier; groups of 16 save 45%, of 32 only 47%. Only images redaction can store again without the dictionary share one (image masks and DeviceGray named directly, at most 64 Mi pixels), and redacting one stores the rest of its group so, which the group bounds to 15.

(M5, #5850 review): Resolve indirect IT when recognizing typewriter contents and Fill & Sign marks. Comment listing and property lookup retain their existing direct-Subtype behavior. A real double-click Edit composer preserves the typewriter’s text as written; ordinary comment edits keep trimming. Regressions cover direct Subtype with indirect intent, save/reopen, raw posted contents and same-index comments on different pages. The existing live-movement test now commits its setup with an outside click rather than Enter. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, #5850): Fill & Sign Enter inserts a line break in a growing editor; clicking outside commits and Escape cancels. Nonempty text keeps leading, internal and trailing line breaks. The headless fillsignadd path sizes its typewriter box for the same wrapped lines so saved appearances show every row. Production-order keyboard and engine save/reopen/render regressions exercise the UI and headless callers. Estimates unchanged.

(community, M7, Thai word breaking): Thai rows end between words, found with ICU4X's dictionary line segmenter (icusegmenter 2.3, compiled dictionary data, no LSTM model; Unicode-3.0), instead of only at spaces when rewrapping and at any cluster in Add text. A row never starts with a following vowel, tone or other mark, Mai Yamok or Paiyannoi, nor ends with a leading vowel; a word wider than the row still breaks between clusters, and the spaces where an Add text row ends are dropped as in Latin text. Rewrapping existing text works out the breaks once per run of non-space characters. Rewriting a paragraph into Thai still needs a source font with the Thai glyphs (there is no Thai fallback face for it yet). The compiled dictionaries (Thai, Lao, Khmer, Burmese) add about 1.8 MB to a stripped release binary. Estimates unchanged.

(M7, #5835): In image crop mode, a right-click on the image, its crop box or its handles keeps the crop and opens no menu, so the menu no longer switches as the pointer moves. A right-click elsewhere clears the selection and opens the page menu. UI tests cover all four page rotations, overlapping images, a 45° image, and a check that the Done/Cancel/Remove Crop pills at a page edge still keep the crop.

(M14 docs, #5805): docs/localization-parity.md and the Languages table here count every catalog with cargo xtask i18n-report: the share of the 2,897 strings in its denominator, on 14ae839a. The catalog-union measure it replaces had grown to 2,895 keys and left four catalogs at "100%" that were 44 keys short. Hindi, Indonesian and Korean are listed with their catalogs (97.5% each) instead of 0, and Thai, Lao and Central Kurdish join the table. The ≈ 68% localization score is not re-scored.

(M10, #5743): macOS print jobs name their title and owner (com.apple.print.JobInfo.PMJobName, PMJobOwner), as the system print dialog does, because a Kyocera filter crashes on a job without them. Checked by a test and through docprint against a stand-in lp; not yet on a physical printer.
(M3, #5708): Pages shorter than the window sit in its middle, one page or row at a time and when scrolling continuously with every page in view.

(M3, #5716): A snapshot is drawn at 300 ppi, or at the zoom if that is finer, so one taken zoomed out stays readable; an area too large for one 4096-pixel tile comes out as fine as a tile allows (about 147 ppi for 2000 pt). A choice of resolution and a selection that stays active remain.
(M14, #5737, #5460): Preferences can turn off the update check at start. It stays on by default, and Help ▸ Check for updates still asks.

(M7, #5657): Header/footer, watermark and background additions and replacements stage the complete call before committing. Synthetic later-page failures preserve exact incremental bytes, object count, dirty state and allocation cursor; success controls retain other marks and shared/inherited resources. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, #5572): Preferences ▸ Documents and view sets how many recent files to keep, from 0 to 50 with 12 by default. At 0 Home has no Recent section and File ▸ Open Recent is disabled. The list is cut when Preferences closes, so the number can pass through 0 on its way to another.

(M5/M14, customizable hotbar, freehand highlight, and moveable navigation rail): Added Freehand-Highlight (/Subtype /Ink, /IT /FreehandHighlight, Multiply blending, 100 pt max line width) inside the standard Highlight flyout and headless commentadd; added a customizable floating or side-docked hotbar with a full-side chrome strip mode, settings gear icon anchored at the bar end, and 24–64 px sizing; and added Left/Right docking for the navigation rail (railside). Focused unit and integration tests pass across annot, automation, and ui-egui. Estimates unchanged.

PR #2155 further review preserves inherited Form text state and soft-mask chronology during Arrange, composes crop-group moves in the proper scope, and uses affine/press-relative image resize plus a shared rotation pivot. No-op script buttons preserve hidden source text; paste coordinates, visible selection ownership, and Snapshot/Export permissions have dedicated regressions. Candidate only; estimates unchanged.

PR #2155 latest follow-up handles explicit image-paste events without release-time guesses, refreshes the font-size field when a selection becomes mixed, and specifies mixed-script normalization with exact Undo restoration. Candidate only; estimates unchanged.

PR #2155 review follow-up preserves editor crops through group moves and keeps arranged artwork outside added-item streams; unsafe nested-tag extraction is refused. Image handles and flips follow page orientation, added images accept general transforms, and clipboard/text/Home/font-discovery edge cases have focused regressions. Candidate only; estimates unchanged.

PR #2155 maintainer edits remove redundant image/text helpers and add regressions for crop ownership, arrange scope/state fidelity, clipboard precedence, crop-drag bounds, and font scanning. Transform and Unicode-script tools complete the headless paths.

(M3/M4, #5330): The document quick toolbar offers Crop pages directly through the existing page.crop command, with the command’s assembly-permission check and an active-tool highlight. The existing crop, undo and headless pagesetbox paths are unchanged. No toolbar customization or new shortcut. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, PR #4172 review): Added same-machine pixel oracles for GBK Song, Hei, Kai and FangSong, including all four subset-prefixed Founder aliases. Reference PDFs use explicit Unicode mappings and independently selected installed faces; font data and rasters remain in memory. All eight cases ran; wrong-glyph and wrong-family production mutations each failed the new assertion and were restored. Validation: 422 renderer unit tests, renderer all-target Clippy with -D warnings, formatting, layers/assets/parity and renderer WASM checks passed; existing optional-patch/WASM warnings and parity notes remain. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, PR #4172): Integrated main fa5f9f8c, retaining both roadmap histories and raster regression groups. Restored displayconfig and thumbnailconfig imports after the upstream explicit-import migration. Validation: 422 renderer unit tests, engine/UI all-target checks, scoped all-target Clippy with -D warnings, formatting, layers, assets, parity and renderer/engine WASM checks passed. Existing optional-patch/WASM warnings and parity notes remain; no full engine/UI runtime test rerun. Display-only font policy and estimates unchanged.

(M7, #2517): Widening a paragraph rejoins a wrap with the number of spaces that wrap consumed, including a typed run and none for a Chinese or Japanese word split. The count survives an incremental save and a full rewrite, and a width-only textedit uses it. Estimates unchanged.

(M2): Scanned pages look like the paper again. An image that doesn't ask for /Interpolate was shrunk by nearest-neighbour (since #635), which kept one sample in N per axis, so the text of a 300 dpi scan at 100% lost most of its strokes; it is now area-averaged to whole device pixels (on a 13-page 300 dpi scan every sample at 96–192 dpi is within 1 of the exact area average; it was up to 255 off). Enlarged, an image of page-scan size is smoothed bilinearly, so a zoomed scan has no staircases; icons, QR codes and pixel art keep hard pixels. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, #4119 partial): Scan & OCR ▸ Enhance scanned file cleans scanned pages in place: background removal (level 0–100, as the camera clean-up), edge shadow removal (book gutters, copier borders) and despeckle. Each scan image is decoded, cleaned and written back into its own object at the same size and colour space (JPEG stays JPEG, others lossless, 1-bit stays 1-bit), so the OCR text layer, comments and links stay; one undo step, shared images once, unsupported images (CMYK, indexed, JPEG 2000, JBIG2, CCITT, broken data) reported. pageenhancescan drives it headlessly. Not yet an option of Recognize text. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, PR #4172): Integrated main 5af10276, preserving both roadmap histories and reviewing auto-merged export tests and accessibility UI changes. Validation: 488 scoped tests passed (18 engine, 412 renderer unit, 43 renderer integration, 15 Combine; one existing renderer integration test ignored); scoped all-target Clippy with -D warnings, formatting, layers, assets, parity and renderer/engine WASM checks passed. Viewer-only CJK fallback and print/output font policy remain unchanged; estimates unchanged.

(M10, #1595): Export to Markdown: docexportoffice with a .md or .markdown path writes CommonMark with GitHub pipe tables (headings, paragraphs with bold and italic, tables with their first row as the header, a rule between pages); text that Markdown would read as markup is escaped. Images, lists and links are not in the export's layout model and are left out. No menu item yet. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, PR #4172 module-split conflicts): Integrated main 1dd2737b, retaining viewer-only CJK fallback in split session modules and Combine thumbnail workers, and moving renderer regressions to the new test module. Validation: 798 scoped tests passed (371 engine, 412 renderer, 15 Combine; two existing engine tests ignored); scoped all-target Clippy with -D warnings, formatting, layers, assets, parity and renderer/engine WASM checks passed. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, ocr.ocr-web, rebase fix): The web build loads OCR models only when their SHA-256 matches ATTRIBUTION.toml. With ONNX loading now on, rten's parser spins forever on some bytes that aren't a model (a corrupt or wrong download), so a bad file now fails at once instead of hanging a worker.

(M3, #3425): A file named with open parameters, as help systems start a PDF reader (manual.pdf#nameddest=Intro, #page=12 or #Intro), opens at that destination instead of failing to read manual.pdf#…: at launch, when another launch hands it over, and in its tab when it is already open. Other parameters are ignored. The app and linkopen now also apply a GoToR link's named destination, looked up in the target's /Names /Dests or catalog /Dests, instead of warning that it wasn't applied; the app looks names up off the UI thread. docopen reports the destination of a path with open parameters. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, OCR models): Model staging downloads and verifies the ONNX pair after the upstream RTEN URL brownout; runtime discovery prefers complete ONNX pairs per directory, retains complete RTEN fallback and preserves directory precedence.

(M2, PR #4172): Reconciled current main, preserving its Japanese serif/weight selection and both branches' progress records. Installed CJK viewer and preview fallback remains display-only; estimates unchanged.

(M11, JBIG2 symbols): Lossless JBIG2 now stores each distinct mark of a black-and-white image once, as a symbol, and places its exact copies, when that is smaller than the generic region: on six pages of rendered 300 dpi text 28% of the generic region's size and 17% of Group 4's, and the same bits back through two independent decoders (hayro-jbig2 and Poppler). Scans, whose letters are seldom identical, gain little until refinement coding; a dictionary shared between pages (/JBIG2Globals) is next. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, ocr.ocr-web, review fix): On the web, Edit on a scanned page starts the OCR model download, and the page is read once the models load; it was taken for no scan and left unread until the document changed.

(M5, comment replies): One reply can be deleted from the Comments panel without its thread. On the selected card each reply has its own "…" menu (Edit, Copy text, Delete); Delete takes that reply with its pop-up and the replies to it, as commentdelete already did headlessly, and the comment and its other replies stay. The card stays selected, and the panel's editor stays open, on what they were on though the delete moved it in /Annots. Undo and Redo close the editor, since either can move what it was open on. A locked reply can't be deleted. Estimates unchanged.

(M7, #2750): Single-style Keep source fonts edits retain source glyphs and batch only missing glyphs in fallback fonts. Per-rewrite character eligibility and widths are cached; source and fallback edge spaces stay extractable. Estimates unchanged.
